content.text:
To create a comprehensive codelist for current, acute Myocardial Infarction, we look for diagnosis codes (e.g., acute myocardial infarction, subsequent myocardial infarction, postoperative myocardial infarction) as well as specific ECG results denoting a new or acute infarct, and specific therapeutic interventions that take place during an acute event. We exclude codes that specify "history of," "old," or "healed" myocardial infarctions, as these indicate the patient had the condition in the past but not necessarily currently. We also exclude codes indicating "suspected" conditions or conditions where an infarction was avoided.
